json.title: Follow up the primitives usage audit before the next design system release
json.subtitle: Three phases: fix the shared primitives, adopt them in the shell, then re-run the audit

plan_steps.title: Inventory every shell component that bypasses the Card primitive
plan_steps.content:
Phase 1: Shared primitives

Grep the shell for hand-built card wrappers and list each one with its file and line in the audit log.
plan_steps.done_note: Done before publish: the inventory ran during the audit pass.

plan_steps.title: Replace the hand-built card wrappers on Home and Plans with the Card primitive
plan_steps.check_label: Home and Plans show the same card padding in light and dark themes
plan_steps.content: Use Card, CardHeader and CardContent. Keep the existing class names only where they carry layout.

plan_steps.title: Align the Button size variants with the design tokens
plan_steps.check_label: Button sizes match the tokens table in DESIGN.md
plan_steps.content: The sm variant uses a hard-coded height. Read the token and remove the literal value.

plan_steps.title: Decide whether the unused Badge variants stay in the component
plan_steps.check_label: Each unused Badge variant is either removed or justified in the component doc

plan_steps.title: Move the plan step checkbox onto the Checkbox primitive
plan_steps.check_label: A step toggles on a phone and on desktop with the same focus ring
plan_steps.content:
Phase 2: Shell adoption

The step checkbox still carries its own focus ring. Confirm it matches the Checkbox primitive once the step card moves over.

plan_steps.title: Replace the progress pill on the Plans list with the Badge primitive
plan_steps.check_label: Each progress state renders with one Badge variant on Plans and on the plan page
plan_steps.content: The pill repeats Badge styling by hand. Keep the three progress states visually distinct: not started, in progress and complete.

plan_steps.title: Retire the PageHeader description fallback for plain strings
plan_steps.check_label: No caller passes a plain string where JSX is expected
plan_steps.content: Only the plan page passes JSX as the description. Confirm every other caller passes a string, then drop the fallback branch.

plan_steps.title: Run the shell test suite on the branch after each adoption change
plan_steps.check_label: The shell test suite passes on the branch after each adoption commit
plan_steps.content: Run the suite on the branch, not only on main, so a failing snapshot is caught before review.

plan_steps.title: Re-render the shell screens in WebKit and compare them with the Phase 1 baseline
plan_steps.check_label: Home, Plans and the plan page match the baseline within the agreed tolerance
plan_steps.content:
Phase 3: Re-run and close

Use the render harness on the audit branch. Save the new screenshots beside the baseline and note any difference that is more than a pixel of drift.

plan_steps.title: Re-run the primitives usage scorecard and record the new totals in the audit log
plan_steps.check_label: The scorecard totals for the shell appear in the audit log
plan_steps.content: Use the same scorecard columns as the baseline so the before and after counts line up row for row.

plan_steps.title: Leave a Resolution comment on each follow-up issue once its change is merged
plan_steps.check_label: Every follow-up issue has a Resolution comment that names its merged commit

plan_steps.title: Publish the before and after summary to the plans view
plan_steps.check_label: The summary page links each finding to the commit that closed it
plan_steps.content: Keep the summary to one page. Put the before and after counts side by side and link every finding to its closing commit.
